title: Domains: .app and .ai offered
why: Jason, 2026-11-17: "can we add .app, .ai to the list of what we would like to offer?" Domains::TLDS gains app and ai, so Shop → Domains, the storefront's search and the Name.com card's Prices we pay table include them. An ending Name.com sells only for longer terms (.ai, from 2 years) opens on its shortest term with Name.com's price for it (Get Pricing for that term; not offered if Name.com gives none), never a 1-year price that can't be bought. FAQ: the endings listed, the longer minimum, and .app's HTTPS-only rule.
